analysis: The only change in this PR is a single test-file line, head line 37 of provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/NemotronSuperLocalOutputTests.swift: `case .logprobs: return "L"` in the trace() helper's exhaustive switch over MLXServerGenerationEvent. This appears to make the test compile after a new `.logprobs` event case was added to the enum elsewhere. The edit is test-only and touches no runtime or production code. It adds no keys, no network paths, no storage, and no authorization or attestation logic. The context-only T-041 prefix-cache definition is unaffected. I checked that the tests around it still assert the existing fail-closed behavior: tool-policy violations, reserved schema metadata refused unless trusted, bounded buffers, and truncation rejection. The logprobs tests (testCompleteLogprobsCarryTheStreamsEntries, testPlanRefusesUnsupportedControlsAndFormatsOnce) are unchanged in this diff. Open question for other passes: the production change that introduced the `.logprobs` event is outside the supplied units. It deserves a check that logprobs and top-logprobs data are subject to the same output validation and tool_choice gating as content, and that they are encrypted with the rest of the response on the provider-to-coordinator leg (T-008, A-001). No evidence of a regression is visible here.
